### Features
- Generated columns are read-only in table data. Cloning a row leaves generated, auto-increment and binary key columns blank.
- Connections are managed on a full-window Connections page, replacing the connection dialog.
- The BLOB viewer loads large values progressively in its text and hex views.

### Improvements
- Tab and Shift+Tab commit cell edits and move between columns.

See release assets for platform installers.
